1.Desc: Defeat is just as commonplace as victory.

2.Desc: Dust yourself off and try again!

3.Desc: Next time you'll make it further! ...Maybe.

4.Desc: How to best start afresh is worth some thought!

5.Desc: Losing faith... That is the true meaning of death.

6.Desc:
This failure is nothing to regret!
Regrets will only lead to missed opportunities.

7.Desc:
Bearer of the Divine Mission,
This was no more than a minor setback.

8.Desc: Do not tempt fate by trying to walk before you can run.

9.Desc: If you were a little stronger, things would be different.

10.Desc: So why not try again, start over?

11.Desc: Success is a word with a sublime ring to it!

12.Desc: Heartiest of praise to the victors!

13.Desc: Have faith, take action, and never give up.

14.Desc: How to keep going will be the bane of your happiness.

15.Desc:
The failures upon which we build our success,
are all founded upon our valor!

16.Desc: The best way to make it past the glass ceiling of setbacks is to smash through it!

17.Desc: Well done! You truly deserve it.

18.Desc: To truly breakthrough means to do something miraculous whilst keeping your feet on the ground.

19.Desc: For the dream, you'll pay; For the rewards, you'll rejoice.

20.Desc: Why not make breakthroughs a habit?
